## How it works

- **Starters** live in a private repository per student in the course's
  GitHub organization. Access instructions are on Canvas, not here.
- **Submit** by committing to that repository. HW1 took browser uploads;
  from HW2 on it is git, which session 7 covers. The commit timestamp is
  the submission time.
- **Figures are not submitted.** The grader runs your code on a fresh
  machine and grades the figures it draws, so commit the code; uploading
  the figures is not needed.
- **Solutions** are posted on this site and linked from the table above.
  Several assignments build on the one before, and a solution can go up
  while the assignment that extends it is still open. That assignment
  still starts from your own submission. What I value most is that you
  understand each change you make to it, including the ones an AI agent
  makes for you. Each solution is a complete project, in the same folder
  layout you were asked to produce.
- **Late work** is not accepted, and your lowest homework score is dropped.
  Documented emergencies: talk to me.
- **AI tools** are permitted by default, with disclosure, except where an
  assignment says otherwise. HW1 says otherwise.

## Rubric

Every assignment is graded on the same three dimensions.
